page.search_description_1: Parent volunteers raising money for Hendricks Avenue Elementary in Jacksonville. We buy what the school budget will not.

act1.photo_text_1: The Friends of Hendricks — Standing Strong for Our School
act1.intro_1: It is six hundred families, {{SPONSOR_COUNT_WORDS}} local businesses, and a budget the school district never provided. We raise what the Duval County School Board budget does not cover — and all of it stays inside one building.

section_3.heading_1: We buy what the budget won't.
section_3.paragraph_1: The Friends of Hendricks is a volunteer group of parents that raises funds for resources and projects the Duval County School Board budget does not cover.
section_3.paragraph_2: In the past, we have funded capital projects, playground equipment, educational software, teacher grants, and classroom supplies.
section_3.text_4: reducing the burden on our teachers
section_3.note_1: All gifts, no matter how large or small, had a meaningful impact because YOU became invested in the education and enrichment of every child, faculty, and staff member.

section_4.photo_text_1: Three Hendricks students in navy 2026 Walkathon shirts, smiling on the track
section_4.paragraph_1: Every shirt is designed by a Hendricks student.
section_4.paragraph_2: 2026 Walkathon · last year's shirt by Claire

ways.paragraph_1: The {{WALK_EDITION}} one, and the biggest day of our year. Students collect pledges, then walk. Family and friends sponsor them online through Zeffy.
ways.paragraph_2: Online through Zeffy, in a minute. 501(c)(3), Tax ID 20-4931978 — ask your employer to match it.
ways.paragraph_3: Your logo on 600 t-shirts, the school marquee, and both entrances. Five levels.
ways.paragraph_4: A before-school Birthday Bash, a treat from Henry, and a classroom book dedicated in your child's honor.
ways.paragraph_5: Hendricks Avenue or San Jose Boulevard. Wish a student luck, celebrate a birthday, thank a teacher, and more.
ways.paragraph_6: Eat out on the night and a share of the bill comes straight back to school.
